title: 24 Hilarious But Genuinely Horrifying Reactions To This 'Explosive' Diarrhea Parasite
text:
'Diarrhea Summer' here we come!
When I was 14, MTV came to my house because I was one of Britney Spears' biggest fans.of a parasite called Cyclospora across 31 states.
The worst part is that nobody knows where it's coming from. The current guess is lettuce, but honestly, they have absolutely no idea!
"I’m gonna be so mad if I’ve survived all this horseshit up until now and then I die of 2026 Diarrhea Lettuce. " "The only good thing to come out of the Cyclospora outbreak is that I’ve finally memorized how to spell diarrhea. " "My survival instincts are telling me to order pizza and wings for dinner tonight just to avoid the cyclospora outbreak.
" "damn the explosive diarrhea parasite got me proactively throwing away the salad kit i was gonna let rot in the back of my produce drawer. " "I didn’t need a diarrhea parasite in order to have a Diet Coke and Uncrustables summer but it’s nice to have an excuse. " "That 32oz bag of frozen broccoli that’s been in my freezer for the last six months is about to step into her main character era. Thanks, Cyclospora. "
